title: fix(runtime): a per-record action called with no recordId is refused 400 naming it, and an unknown id 404s at the door
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB7J3TmFTYMYQrfpye6GQNg9)_

Fixes #29881

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么:** 声明 `execution: 'perRecord'` 的动作（api 型或 flow 型）在两个动作门（REST `/actions` 与 MCP `run_action`）缺 `recordId`（或为空串）时，入流程/转发前即答 `400 VALIDATION_ERROR` 指名 `recordId`；同一 api 动作带一个调用者解析不到的 id 时，答门自己的 `404 RECORD_NOT_FOUND`，不再转发。
- **为什么改:** showcase 的 `showcase_recalc_estimate` 是 `type: 'api'` 指向 flow 端点（卡片以为是 flow 型动作，实为 api 型）；缺 id 或 id 不存在时都转发进流程，拿回 `400 FLOW_FAILED` 和内部节点名 `load_task`。#28932 只按 `target` 里的 `{id}` 令牌判，这里 target 无令牌，所以改读动作自己的 `execution` 声明。
- **风险与回滚:** 被拒的调用在 `main` 上本来就失败（同 #29005 的判法，`Clause-②: no`）；`aggregate` 与未声明 `execution` 的动作照旧无 id 运行（#29173），审批动作未声明 `execution`，#28657 的转发不动。`@objectstack/runtime` patch。回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- **先看:** `packages/runtime/src/action-execution.ts` 的 `perRecordActionRecordIdRefusal` 及其两处调用（`buildApiActionRequest`、`dispatchFlowAction`），和 `forwardsOnDeniedSubjectLoad` 新增的一行。
- **两分钟验证:** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run src/action-flow-per-record-record-id.test.ts src/domains/api-action-forward.test.ts`，预期 `92 passed`。
- **需要你做的:** 无，席位评审并落地。

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What changes

- **`@objectstack/runtime`, `action-execution.ts`.** A new `perRecordActionRecordIdRefusal(action, recordId)` answers `{ status: 400, message }` when the action declares `execution: 'perRecord'` and no record id was given (`undefined`, `null` or `''`). It reads only the declaration and the id. The message has the #28932 shape, and names `recordId` and the declaration:
  ```
  Action 'showcase_recalc_estimate' is declared `execution: 'perRecord'` — it runs on one record — and no `recordId` was given. Pass the id of the record to run it on as `recordId`. Nothing was run.
  ```
  It is read in two places, and both doors reach both:
  - **api arm:** `buildApiActionRequest`, right beside #28932's `target`-token refusal, so nothing is forwarded;
  - **flow arm:** the top of `dispatchFlowAction`, thrown with `status: 400` and the code derived from it (`VALIDATION_ERROR`), so no run is created and no node's diagnostic reaches the caller.
- **`forwardsOnDeniedSubjectLoad`** returns `false` for an action declared `execution: 'perRecord'`. A per-record api action whose record the caller's scope does not resolve (an unknown id, or a row it cannot read; the two are one answer by design) gets the door's shared `404 RECORD_NOT_FOUND` before anything runs, as a flow or script action already did. Before, it was forwarded, and the recalc flow answered `400 FLOW_FAILED` wrapping "Record … not found".
- Nothing else moves. Actions declared `aggregate`, or declaring no `execution`, run record-less as before (#29173). `approval_approve` (the #28657 shape) declares no `execution` and keeps forwarding on a denied load. `action-execution.ts` is not re-exported from the package entry, so the new function adds nothing to the public surface.

## Why

Card #29881: `POST /api/v1/actions/showcase_task/showcase_recalc_estimate {}` answered `400 FLOW_FAILED` with "Node 'recalc_each' failed: … Node 'load_task' failed: get_record: refusing to run — 1 filter operand(s) evaluated to nothing: `recordId`…". With an unknown id it answered the same code wrapping "Record … not found". The caller could not tell that it had left out an argument, and the flow's internal node names reached it.

**Premise readings (measured at `18112bfa`):**
- The card's two actions are not flow-bodied. Both are `type: 'api'` actions whose `target` (`/api/v1/apps/showcase/recalc`) is a `type: 'flow'` endpoint. #28932's check reads the `target` for a record token, and this target has none, so the call was forwarded with no id. The per-record signal the platform already has is the action's own `execution` declaration (`ActionSchema.execution`, #17319). The fix reads that for the api arm, and also for `type: 'flow'` actions, which had the same gap.
- `showcase_recalc_selection` is declared `execution: 'aggregate'`. It is NOT per-record, and #29173 deliberately lets a record-less aggregate call through, so it keeps running with no id. It is this PR's "not per-record keeps running" control. What its endpoint makes of an empty selection (the same `FLOW_FAILED` with node names) belongs to that flow, not the action door, and this PR leaves it as it is.
- Unknown id: #28932's own arm (`approval_approve`) does not 404 at the door. It forwards, and the approvals route answers its own `404 REQUEST_NOT_FOUND`. Matching that here would still hand the caller the flow's node names, so the per-record declaration also opts the action out of the #28657 forward-on-denied-load exception. The door's existing `404 RECORD_NOT_FOUND` envelope is used, and no new code is added.

**Accept set (`Clause-②: no`, the #29005 reading).** Every call refused now already failed on `main`. With no id, the forward ran a flow that refused at its first read. With an unresolvable id, it ran a flow that could not read the row as the caller (`runAs: 'user'`). In-repo census of `execution: 'perRecord'`: four showcase actions. Two are `operation: 'update'` (that arm is untouched). Two are api actions: the recalc one, and `showcase_generate_invoice_pdf` → `/api/v1/print/records`, whose route reads the record as the caller. No plugin package declares `perRecord`.

## Verification

- **Unit, `packages/runtime/src/domains/api-action-forward.test.ts`**, new `[#29881]` describe, through the real `HttpDispatcher` REST door and `invokeBusinessAction` (MCP):
  - with `{}`, `{ params: {} }` and `{ recordId: '' }`, the request is refused `400 VALIDATION_ERROR` naming `recordId`, and the target is never called;
  - an unresolvable id gets `404 RECORD_NOT_FOUND`, and nothing is forwarded;
  - controls: a real id is forwarded with `{ recordId }`, and the aggregate twin with no id is forwarded;
  - helpers: `forwardsOnDeniedSubjectLoad` is false for per-record and true for aggregate and undeclared; `buildApiActionRequest` builds no request without an id.
- **Unit, `packages/runtime/src/action-flow-per-record-record-id.test.ts`** (new): a `type: 'flow'` per-record action, on both doors, is refused 400 naming `recordId`, and `automation.execute` is never called. An unknown id keeps the 404. A real id runs. Aggregate and undeclared flow actions run with no id.
- **Real HTTP, `packages/qa/dogfood/test/api-action-door-forward.dogfood.test.ts`**, new `[#29881]` case on a booted stock showcase, as admin:
  - `showcase_recalc_estimate` with `{}` and with `{ recordId: '' }` answers 400 `VALIDATION_ERROR` naming `recordId`; the body contains neither `load_task` nor `FLOW_FAILED`;
  - an unknown id answers 404 `RECORD_NOT_FOUND` with no `load_task`;
  - a seeded task answers 200;
  - `showcase_recalc_selection {}` is not refused at the door.
  - The file has 11 tests, all passed.
- **Ablations**, each run once and restored:
  1. Unit: the three call sites removed (helper kept so the import resolves): 6 failed, every new negative pin, e.g. `REST: no recordId … answers 400 VALIDATION_ERROR` → `AssertionError: {}: expected 200 to be 400`, and the 404 pin → `expected 200 to be 404`. Restored: 92 passed.
  2. Real HTTP: runtime rebuilt from `main`'s `action-execution.ts`. The `[#29881]` case failed with the card's body verbatim: `{"code":"FLOW_FAILED","message":"Node 'recalc_each' failed: map 'recalc_each': item 0 (subflow 'showcase_recalc_task_estimate') failed: Node 'load_task' failed: get_record: refusing to run — 1 filter operand(s) evaluated to nothing: \`recordId\` …"}: expected 'FLOW_FAILED' to be 'VALIDATION_ERROR'`. Rebuilt with the fix: 11 passed.
- **Build and suites:** the `@objectstack/runtime...` closure build: exit 0. The `@objectstack/dogfood^...` closure build: exit 0. Runtime `pnpm test`: 540 files, 8614 passed / 19 skipped, exit 0. `test:repo`: 3 files, 1211 passed, exit 0. `tsc --noEmit`: exit 0. `check:test-typecheck`: exit 0.
- **`pnpm lint`:** exit 0.
- **`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`** at the change set vs `origin/main` `18112bfa`: 64 derived commands, all exit 0, with two notes:
  - `check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` first exited 3 because its fixture commit `621a4876` was not in the shallow clone; after fetching it: 48 cases pass, exit 0.
  - `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` first exited 3 because 7 package dists were missing; after building them: exit 0 (116 entry points, 71 packages).
  - The 5 artifact-roster gates whose roster sits under a path this diff touches (`check:authz-resolver`, `check:changeset-fixed`, `check:error-code-casing`, `check:filter-alias-parity`, `check:route-ledger-census`): all exit 0.
  - `dispatch-gates --ran`: `✓ 64 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 64 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED`.
  - The gates ran on commit `63068066`. The pushed head `3648acbb` is the same tree: only the commit message was reworded, for the trailer hook.
- **Serial:** no open PR found touching the action door's per-record path. The one open PR a search returned (#29970) edits only `ui/` files.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (spec untouched)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes.
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: n/a.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English (the `维护者速读` section is the seat's Chinese summary for the maintainer).
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
